bias.label: Leaning down below 3,944; lowest since 4 Nov

event: US jobless claims today, likely 15:30 SAST (time UNVERIFIED). US PPI on Fri 13 Nov (time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Support broke
bullets.text: Gold fell from about 3,964 at 09:20 SAST (FXEmpire) to about 3,927-3,933 (Trading Economics, time UNVERIFIED), which is under the 3,944 support.

bullets.title: Lowest since 4 Nov
bullets.text: FXEmpire says gold hit its lowest level since 4 Nov after hot US inflation data and hawkish Fed comments.

bullets.title: Oversold, not turned
bullets.text: FXEmpire notes the 2-hour RSI near 29, which is oversold, but price is still making lower lows.

bullets.title: Dollar and yields
bullets.text: The dollar index is about 102.90, near its highest since April 2025, and the US 10-year yield is about 4.99% (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: December hike priced
bullets.text: Trading Economics puts December hike odds near 91% and FXEmpire says a hike is fully priced, after October core CPI rose 0.3% versus 0.2% expected.

bullets.title: Central banks buying
bullets.text: Central banks bought 321 t in Q3 and China added about 25.8 t in October (FXEmpire), which can slow deep drops.

levels.note: FXEmpire quote 3,964.29 at 09:20 SAST and the earlier 3,968.82 low (Mitrade)
Goldman 3,850 (via Mitrade) and LiteFinance target zone 3,844-3,813

buy.title: Buy plan: hold at 3,879-3,896 (counter-trend)

keys.label: Buy zone
keys.value: 3,879-3,896, only after a dip that holds

look: This is counter-trend. The bias is down, so use half size or skip it.
Price reaching 3,879-3,896 and a 15M close back up out of the zone.
A 1H higher low inside the zone.
The dollar index easing back below 102.7.
Take some profit at 3,919 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Buying now just because RSI is oversold. Oversold can stay oversold in a strong-dollar trend.
Strong jobless claims today or a hot PPI on Friday can push price straight through the zone.
LiteFinance flags 3,844-3,813 if support keeps breaking, so the zone may not hold.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan: retest of 3,944-3,949
look: Price bouncing back up to 3,944-3,949 and stalling there.
A clear 15M rejection wick or bearish close inside the zone.
The dollar index holding near 102.85 or higher.
Take some profit at 3,919 and move the stop to entry only after that.
watch: Selling now at 3,930, after a big drop and near 3,919 support. Wait for the retest instead.
Oversold markets can snap back hard, so a 1H close above 3,960 can run to 3,969 or 3,992.
Jobless claims at about 15:30 SAST can move gold fast either way. Avoid entering just before it.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
